description: Java servlet tag class responsible for generating product image URLs within a web application, specifically for the Shopizer platform. It constructs image URLs based on request context, store configuration, and product details.

classes.name: ProductImageUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag class for rendering product image URLs based on store configuration and product details.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and prints the product image URL, handling exceptions and using request/session attributes to build URL.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Indicates processing of the tag has completed, allowing the JSP page to continue rendering.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Setter for the Product object related to this tag.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Getter for the Product object related to this tag.
